abilities._comment: 'If this has 6 or more {p}, it gets go again.' WHILE_STATIC is not just the shape conditional_keywords needs, it is the RIGHT reading: the condition is about this card's CURRENT power, which a pump can change after the attack is declared, and go again is paid at the Resolution Step (CR 8.3.5b). An ON_ATTACK trigger froze the answer at declaration; it also left the printed GoAgain unconditional, so a 4-power Chain of Brutality had go again anyway.
If this has 6 or more {p}: when this hits a hero, the next attack action card you play this turn has 6 BASE {p}. Was a flat +4 with no power condition and no go again.

_comment: Added the missing ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO gate: the DSL ON_HIT listener is wired to the generic 'hit' event, which fires for ANY damaged target, and ON_ATTACK fires on declaration whatever was attacked -- so 'when this hits/attacks A HERO' also fired against allies and permanents.
